name: subflow
description: SubFlow — real-time speech captions with optional LLM translation, powered by cloud STT.
author: mochizuki0323 <motiduki0323@gmail.com>

scripts.dist:win:linux: OPENSSL_STATIC=1 npm run build:backend:mingw && npm run sync:mingw-exe && npm run build:frontend && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win portable zip --x64 && node scripts/rename-release-artifacts.js
scripts.build:frontend: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && vite build
scripts.dist: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder && node scripts/rename-release-artifacts.js
